meaning: pester and keep someone tied up

english.note: Use this when a person or problem persistently pesters or beleaguers someone rather than physically attacking a place.
Pick this when a person or task keeps someone occupied or tied up for a period of time.

examples.english: Those troublesome customers constantly besiege me, leaving me no time to work.
examples.traditional: 啲麻煩客成日纏住我，搞到我冇時間做嘢。

examples.english: That customer can occupy me all morning, leaving me no time to eat.
examples.traditional: 嗰個客可以纏住我成朝，搞到我冇時間食飯。
